scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,mes,agent" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:mes" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@nexushub/client-sdk run build && npm --workspace=@nexushub/portal-backend run build && npm --workspace=@nexushub/mes-engine run build && npm --workspace=@nexushub/client-agent run build && npm --workspace=@nexushub/portal-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/client-sdk/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/portal-backend/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/portal-frontend/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/mes-engine/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/client-agent/tsconfig.json
scripts.sonar:db:init: docker exec nexushub-postgres psql -U postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='sonar'" | grep -q 1 || docker exec nexushub-postgres psql -U postgres -c "CREATE USER sonar WITH PASSWORD 'sonarpassword'"; docker exec nexushub-postgres psql -U postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='sonar'" | grep -q 1 || docker exec nexushub-postgres psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE sonar OWNER sonar"
scripts.sonar:up: npm run sonar:db:init && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.sonarqube.yml --profile sonarqube up -d sonarqube
scripts.sonar:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.sonarqube.yml --profile sonarqube rm --stop --force sonarqube
scripts.sonar: if [ -z "$SONAR_TOKEN" ]; then echo '❌ SONAR_TOKEN belum diset. Contoh: export SONAR_TOKEN=sqa_xxx (lihat README bagian SonarQube)'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -z "$(docker ps -q -f name=nexushub-sonarqube)" ]; then docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/usr/src" -e SONAR_HOST_URL=http://sonarqube:9000 -e SONAR_TOKEN --network "$(docker inspect nexushub-sonarqube --format '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$k}}{{end}}')" sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli:latest; else echo '❌ SonarQube belum jalan. Jalankan dulu: npm run sonar:up (tunggu ~2-3 menit hingga UI aktif di http://localhost:9000)'; exit 1; fi
